chunks: From him, from al-Hasan, from his father, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, who said:
Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام was asked about a man who does not go out on the Day of al-Fitr and al-Adha: is there a salat (prayer) upon him by himself? He said: Yes.

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the Imam answering the legal question
key_terms.صَلَاةٌ: the ritual prayer being asked about as a legal duty
key_terms.نَعَمْ: an affirmative answer establishing the ruling
key_terms.وَحْدَهُ: by himself, individually rather than in congregation

ai.seo_question: If someone does not go out for the Eid prayer, must he still pray by himself?
ai.summary: This hadith states that if a man does not go out for the Eid prayer on the days of al-Fitr and al-Adha, a salat (prayer) is still due from him individually. It relates to the legal discussion of Eid prayer and its performance when not offered with the Imam.
